title: TXA：时间与方案
TXA: timing and regimen
anchor: ≤3 h；1 g 静滴 ≥10 min → 1 g 静脉维持 8 h以本院规范为准。
≤3 h; 1 g IV over ≥10 min → 1 g IV over 8 h Follow institutional policy.
scope: 成人创伤活动/疑似严重出血；从受伤起算。
Adults with active/suspected major traumatic bleeding; time from injury.
decision: 尽早使用；国内 R33 维持表述为“8 h以上”，欧洲 R23 为8 h。以本院规范为准。
Give early; Chinese R33 states at least eight hours for maintenance, European R23 eight hours. Follow institutional policy.
upgrade: 超过3 h不常规使用；仅有黏弹性检测纤溶亢进证据时由上级结合本院方案决定，已知纤溶抑制者不用。以本院规范为准。
Beyond three hours, not routine; only with viscoelastic hyperfibrinolysis evidence and senior/local-policy review; avoid known fibrinolytic shutdown. Follow institutional policy.
comparisonNote: 按本院药品说明书、配制及输注流程执行；不得快速静推。
Follow local product, preparation and infusion policy; avoid rapid IV push.

anchor: SBP 80–90 mmHg以本院规范为准。

Early adult bleeding before control, without brain/spinal injury.
decision: 老年、慢性高血压慎重；儿童与孕妇另按专门方案。
Caution with older age/chronic hypertension; separate pediatric/pregnancy protocols.
upgrade: 目标达不到可按欧洲R14加去甲肾上腺素；国内R28在MAP<50或SBP<70危及生命时考虑，不能替代血液和止血。以本院规范为准。

If targets fail, consider norepinephrine (European R14); Chinese R28 considers it in life-threatening MAP below50 or SBP below70, alongside blood/control rather than replacing them. Follow institutional policy.
comparisonNote: 国内R22与欧洲R13支持有条件的目标；不是所有伤者通用。
Chinese R22 / European R13 support conditional use, not a universal target.

title: 休克指数
Shock index
anchor: SI≥1 或脉压<30 mmHg（国内R2）以本院规范为准。
SI at least one or pulse pressure below30 mmHg (Chinese R2) Follow institutional policy.
scope: 成人风险识别，结合查体与趋势。
Adult risk recognition, with examination and trends.
decision: 国内表2：SI≥1.0/≥1.5/≥2.0粗估失血20–30%/30–50%/50–70%；β阻滞剂、老幼及运动员可失真，不能当精确失血量。以本院规范为准。

Blunted HR or apparently normal older-adult vitals do not exclude shock.
comparisonNote: 欧洲R5用SI和/或脉压评估休克与输血需求；同时看机制、意识、灌注、乳酸和反应。

title: 大量输血启动评估
MTP activation assessment
anchor: ABC ≥2 + 临床状态以本院规范为准。
ABC ≥2 + clinical state Follow institutional policy.
scope: 成人；ACS TQIP 评分示例。
Adults; ACS TQIP example.
decision: 穿透躯干伤、FAST阳性、HR≥120、SBP≤90各1分；ABC≥2启动评估；原版等号边界与本院版本核对。以本院规范为准。

title: 离子钙

anchor: iCa≥1.00 mmol/L（国内）；欧洲正常范围1.1–1.3 mmol/L以本院规范为准。
iCa at least1.00 mmol/L (Chinese); European normal1.1–1.3 mmol/L Follow institutional policy.
scope: 成人大出血，尤其大量输血。
Adult major bleeding, especially massive transfusion.
decision: 开始输血即测iCa；10%氯化钙10 mL约元素钙270 mg，10%葡萄糖酸钙10 mL约90 mg；补低钙时核对浓度、通路及复测。以本院规范为准。

Measure iCa at transfusion start; 10 mL of10% calcium chloride contains about270 mg elemental calcium, versus about90 mg in10% calcium gluconate. Verify concentration/access and recheck. Follow institutional policy.
upgrade: 输血仍在进行、iCa下降或心律变化：及时团队复评。
Ongoing transfusion, falling iCa or rhythm changes: prompt reassessment.
comparisonNote: 欧洲R31推荐氯化钙纠正低钙；上述为元素钙含量对照，不是两药逐毫升互换处方。国内R27下限与欧洲正常范围分开理解。

title: 重型颅脑伤：灌注目标
Severe TBI: perfusion target
anchor: MAP ≥80 mmHg以本院规范为准。
MAP ≥80 mmHg Follow institutional policy.
scope: 重型TBI（GCS ≤8）；不能套用允许性低血压。
Severe TBI (GCS ≤8); avoid permissive hypotension.
decision: GCS9–15且伤后≤3 h可按CRASH-3讨论TXA；TBI出血血小板目标>100×10⁹/L（欧洲R30）；创伤性ICH用TEG/ROTEM指导凝血纠正（NCS/SCCM2026）。以本院规范为准。

Changing consciousness/pupils or unmet goals: address oxygenation/perfusion and escalate neurological care.

anchor: ≥65 岁；SBP <110 mmHg以本院规范为准。

title: BTAI：先分级，再安排TEVAR

title: 肝/脾损伤：生理决定路径

先报告E/V/M与瞳孔
Report E/V/M and pupils
rows: 重型TBI：SBP≥100（50–69岁），≥110（15–49岁或>70岁）；国内MAP≥80 mmHg。CPP60–70 mmHg、ICP>22 mmHg需处理；BTF压力证据III级，ICP/CPP为IIB级。以本院规范为准。

Severe TBI: SBP at least100 at50–69 years, at least110 at15–49 or over70; Chinese MAP at least80 mmHg. CPP60–70, treat ICP over22; BTF pressure evidence LevelIII, ICP/CPP LevelIIB. Follow institutional policy.
GCS≤8、保护反射丧失或脑疝提示气管插管评估；同时预氧合、SMR、纠正低血压。报GCS分项、不可评估因素、双瞳大小/反射；GCS-P=总分减无反应瞳孔数。以本院规范为准。

GCS at most8, lost protective reflexes or herniation prompts airway/intubation evaluation with preoxygenation, SMR and pressure correction. Report components, confounders and both pupils; GCS-P subtracts the count of unreactive pupils. Follow institutional policy.

title: 正常通气，不常规过度通气
Normoventilate, avoid routine hyperventilation
rows: 国内SpO₂至少90%、理想>95%；ACS目标≥94%。无颅内高压时PaCO₂/PetCO₂参考35–45 mmHg，休克时EtCO₂不能替代动脉血气。以本院规范为准。

Chinese SpO₂ floor90%, ideally over95%; ACS target at least94%. Without intracranial hypertension, PaCO₂/PetCO₂ reference35–45 mmHg; shock invalidates assuming EtCO₂ equals arterial CO₂. Follow institutional policy.
脑疝可短时救援通气，先35–38、必要时32–35 mmHg，严密监测并连接确定性治疗；不能对所有TBI持续降CO₂。以本院规范为准。

Herniation permits brief rescue ventilation, initially35–38, if necessary32–35 mmHg, with close monitoring and definitive treatment; do not persistently lower CO₂ for all TBI. Follow institutional policy.

title: 高渗治疗：适应证与原文差异
Hyperosmolar therapy: indication and source differences
脑疝/颅内高压，由授权团队实施
Herniation/raised ICP, authorized team
rows: 国内2025推荐17：3%盐水2 mL/kg、避免Na⁺>155 mmol/L；监测钠、氯、肾功能与容量，不作院前预防性给药。以本院规范为准。
Chinese2025 recommendation17:3% saline2 mL/kg, avoid sodium over155 mmol/L; monitor sodium/chloride/renal function/volume, not routine prehospital prophylaxis. Follow institutional policy.
甘露醇采用ENLS成人0.5–1 g/kg参考；国内原文20%制剂mL/kg与括注g/kg存在换算不一致，不能照抄体积。按本院制剂、渗透压和血压核算；BTF第4版未确立优选药/剂量。以本院规范为准。

Use ENLS adult mannitol0.5–1 g/kg reference. The Chinese text contains inconsistent20% mL/kg versus g/kg conversion: do not copy the volume. Verify formulation, osmolality and pressure locally; BTF4 does not establish a preferred agent/dose. Follow institutional policy.

title: TXA与CT：同名处置，不同人群
TXA and CT: same intervention, different scope
TXA两种方案不得叠加
Do not stack the two TXA regimens
rows: 国内推荐22：伤后3 h内1 g缓慢静脉给药>10 min，随后1 g维持≥8 h。NICE：≥16岁、GCS≤12、无活动性颅外出血，伤后2 h内考虑2 g静脉单次，在影像前实施。以本院规范为准。

Chinese recommendation22: within three hours,1 g slow IV over ten minutes, then1 g over at least eight hours. NICE: age at least16, GCS at most12, no active extracranial bleeding: consider a single2 g IV dose within two hours, before imaging. Follow institutional policy.
CRASH-3早用的轻中度亚组获益较清楚；不能承诺所有重型均获益。先确认已给剂量与伤后时刻，再选本院一种方案。以本院规范为准。

CRASH-3 benefit is clearer with early use in mild/moderate subgroups; benefit is not established for all severe cases. Check prior dose/injury time and choose one local regimen. Follow institutional policy.

title: 成人NICE，儿童按年龄分层
Adult NICE, age-specific pediatric tools
rows: 成人1 h CT：GCS≤12、2 h仍<15、颅底/开放凹陷骨折疑征、创伤后癫痫、局灶异常或呕吐>1次。曾意识丧失/遗忘者另核查≥65岁、凝血障碍、危险机制或逆行遗忘>30 min。以本院规范为准。

Adult one-hour CT: GCS at most12, under15 at two hours, suspected basal/open depressed fracture, seizure, focal deficit or more than one vomiting episode. With LOC/amnesia, also assess age at least65, coagulopathy, dangerous mechanism or retrograde amnesia over30 minutes. Follow institutional policy.
抗凝/抗血小板（不含单用阿司匹林）按NICE1.5.13考虑8 h内CT，伤后>8 h就诊考虑1 h内；加拿大规则不用于抗凝者。PECARN仅轻度钝性儿童头伤，<2岁与≥2岁分开，不能套成人或重伤。以本院规范为准。

For anticoagulant/antiplatelet use except aspirin alone, NICE1.5.13 considers CT within eight hours, or one hour if presentation after eight. Canadian rule excludes anticoagulation. PECARN covers minor blunt pediatric head injury with separate under-two and older rules, not adults/severe trauma. Follow institutional policy.

title: 十分钟恶化：胸膜、止血与四联征
Ten-minute decline: pleura, hemorrhage and lethal diamond
15 L/min储氧下仍SpO₂87%
SpO₂87% despite15 L/min reservoir
rows: 教学新增EFAST：左胸膜无滑动、右侧有滑动、无明显心包液；结合左呼吸音减低、BP78/48，立即由受训团队减压/胸引并复评，不等CT。以本院规范为准。

Synthetic EFAST addition: absent left pleural sliding, right sliding present, no clear pericardial fluid. With reduced left sounds and BP78/48, trained teams decompress/drain and reassess without CT delay. Follow institutional policy.
到院SI126/86≈1.47、ABC≥2：启动本院大量输血路径评估，血液与源控制同步。以本院规范为准。
Arrival SI126/86 about1.47, ABC at least2: activate assessment for the institutional massive-transfusion pathway while controlling the source. Follow institutional policy.

title: 低温、酸中毒、凝血、低钙一起看
Temperature, acidosis, coagulation and calcium
rows: 大出血Fib≤1.5 g/L考虑补充；iCa欧洲1.1–1.3 mmol/L、国内≥1.00；已给Fib1.7/iCa1.05是复查点，不应冒充已达补充阈值。以本院规范为准。

Major bleeding Fib at most1.5 g/L prompts replacement assessment; European iCa1.1–1.3 mmol/L, Chinese at least1.00. Given Fib1.7/iCa1.05 prompt review, not false claims that every replacement threshold is crossed. Follow institutional policy.
无TBI出血期SBP80–90；重型TBI MAP≥80 mmHg，不能套允许性低压。保温、气体/乳酸/VEM复查；PaCO₂35–40 mmHg需与脑/肺状态匹配。以本院规范为准。

Without TBI, bleeding-phase SBP80–90; severe TBI MAP at least80 mmHg excludes permissive hypotension. Warm and repeat gases/lactate/VEM; PaCO₂35–40 must fit brain/lung physiology. Follow institutional policy.

title: 不稳定骨盆：固定与确定性止血
Unstable pelvis: stabilization and definitive control
不稳定定义
Instability definition
rows: WSES：SBP<90，或需持续补液/输血/升压药维持；BD>6 mmol/L、SI>1或24 h需4–6 U RBC也是风险依据，单位不可跨国直接折算。以本院规范为准。

WSES: SBP below90 or maintained by ongoing fluids/blood/vasopressors; BD over6, SI over1 or4–6 RBC units in24 hours also indicate risk. Do not directly convert national component units. Follow institutional policy.

title: 大转子→分流止血
Greater trochanters→control pathway
rows: 骨盆带中心位于大转子/耻骨联合水平；无相关肢体禁忌时双膝并拢、踝内旋，避免反复挤压分离试验。同步血液、保温、TXA及其他出血源检查。以本院规范为准。

Center the binder at greater trochanters/symphysis level; knees together and internal leg rotation when associated injuries allow. Avoid repeated springing. Coordinate blood, warming, TXA and other-source checks. Follow institutional policy.
骨盆带→动脉出血且不需开腹：血管造影栓塞；需开腹/快速控制：腹膜外填塞+外固定。REBOA Zone III仅受训团队为疑盆腔来源、极不稳定者的过渡，不是所有路径的必经最后一步。以本院规范为准。

Binder→arterial bleeding without laparotomy need: AE; laparotomy/rapid control need: preperitoneal packing plus external fixation. ZoneIII REBOA is a skilled-team bridge in extreme instability with suspected pelvic source, not a mandatory final step. Follow institutional policy.

title: 去除也有计划
Removal needs a plan
rows: NICE1.2.17：全部骨盆带24 h内去除；不稳定骨折先与骨盆外科确定替代固定。国内旧共识≤36 h条目需作者核对原文，不用较长上限替代现有移除计划。以本院规范为准。

NICE1.2.17 removes all binders within24 hours, with an alternative stabilization plan for unstable fractures. The older Chinese at-most36-hour clause awaits author original-text verification; do not use it to extend current removal plans. Follow institutional policy.

title: 本地队列：让作者数据与病例各自清楚
Local cohort: distinguish author data and case evidence
IJEM2025作者补充框
IJEM2025 author evidence slot
rows: 论文DOI10.1186/s12245-025-00990-5。作者请填：研究期间、样本数、纳排标准、主要结局及调整结果；本例是否入组未确认，不作推断。以本院规范为准。

Paper DOI10.1186/s12245-025-00990-5. Author fields: study period, sample size, eligibility, outcomes and adjusted results. Whether this case entered the cohort is unconfirmed. Follow institutional policy.

title: 先识别失代偿，再安排止血去向
Recognize decompensation before choosing hemorrhage destination
首次低压已经触发升级
Initial hypotension already demands escalation
rows: 原记录SBP67伴低氧，不能等58 mmHg再启动。相对心动过缓应询问β阻滞剂/抗凝药，但不能据此否认休克。FAST原始结果、年龄、Hb、乳酸、BE、GCS分项均保留未知。以本院规范为准。

Original SBP67 with hypoxemia warrants escalation before58. Relative bradycardia prompts beta-blocker/anticoagulant history but does not negate shock. Original FAST, age, Hb, lactate, BE and GCS components remain unknown. Follow institutional policy.
条件练习：不稳定+FAST阳性且复苏无反应→直接损伤控制剖腹；疑盆腔来源同步骨盆带/填塞路径。血液优先、TXA时间核查；不得把条件设定写为原病历已完成。以本院规范为准。

Conditional exercise: unstable positive FAST with no response→damage-control laparotomy; suspected pelvis→binder/packing pathway. Prioritize blood and check TXA timing; do not describe proposed care as performed. Follow institutional policy.

title: 颈髓与髋关节：保护和复位一起设计
Cord and hip: plan protection and reduction together
中央脊髓风险
Central cord risk
rows: 双上肢烧灼痛/运动异常而下肢相对保留：考虑中央脊髓综合征，补ASIA/ISNCSCI运动感觉及骶段检查，不凭症状确诊。弹射/感觉异常为高危：全程SMR、CT；有脊髓神经异常则CT后MRI。以本院规范为准。

Bilateral arm burning pain/weakness with relative leg sparing raises central-cord concern. Complete ASIA/ISNCSCI motor/sensory/sacral assessment, not symptom-only diagnosis. Ejection/paresthesia are high risk: SMR and CT, then MRI for cord abnormalities. Follow institutional policy.

title: 髋脱位尽早复位
Reduce hip dislocation urgently
rows: 尽早、常以伤后6 h内为研究比较目标，不能等待至6 h；复位前后记录坐骨神经及腓总支、血运，复位后CT查骨折/游离体/同心复位，随访股骨头坏死。以本院规范为准。

Reduce urgently; six hours is a research comparison reference, not permission to wait. Document sciatic/peroneal function and perfusion before/after; post-reduction CT assesses fracture/fragments/congruence, followed by AVN surveillance. Follow institutional policy.
镇静减轻痛苦但须独立监护、波形CO₂、复苏与气道救援准备，维持SMR并说明麻醉/骨科角色。ACEP2026强调容量不足者在可行时先纠正。以本院规范为准。

Sedation needs dedicated monitoring, waveform CO₂, resuscitation/airway rescue and maintained SMR with anesthesia/orthopedic roles. ACEP2026 recommends correcting volume depletion first where feasible. Follow institutional policy.

title: 开放骨盆：止血、污染与器官损伤
Open pelvis: bleeding, contamination and organ injury
尽早抗生素与会阴评估
Early antibiotics and perineal assessment
rows: 早期静脉抗生素，NICE开放骨折尽量伤后1 h内；会阴伤口保护、污染记录，疑直肠伤由受训者直肠指检，阳性行直肠镜。以本院规范为准。

Early IV antibiotics; NICE open-fracture goal within one hour. Protect perineal wounds/document contamination; trained digital rectal assessment when rectal injury suspected, proctoscopy if positive. Follow institutional policy.
清创/填塞与血液复苏并行；直肠/泌尿伤评估后选择粪便转流或耻骨上膀胱造瘘，不是所有患者常规。以下是教学路径，未在原记录确认的措施不标作已实施。以本院规范为准。

Debridement/packing and blood resuscitation proceed together. Fecal diversion or suprapubic drainage depends on rectal/urinary injury, not routine for everyone. Proposed teaching pathways are not documented performed care. Follow institutional policy.
原始生命体征、Hb/乳酸/BE不足，不生成看似真实的轨迹。另作模拟时须明确合成并与真实病例分离。以本院规范为准。
Do not create a plausible real trajectory when original vitals/Hb/lactate/BE are missing. Any simulation must be distinctly synthetic. Follow institutional policy.

title: 混合休克：提前检查心包与过敏
Mixed shock: assess pericardium and allergy early
早期EFAST包含心包
Early EFAST includes pericardium
rows: 原FAST只记录腹腔/胸膜阴性，不能视为心包阴性；剑突下心包窗、泵功能与右心负荷应在持续休克早期补查，不等第8轮。Hb数值及CT是否增强未在源资料确认，保留未知。以本院规范为准。

Original FAST records negative abdomen/pleura, not a negative pericardium. Add subxiphoid view, pump function and right-heart assessment early in persistent shock, not at round8. Hb and contrast-CT status are unconfirmed. Follow institutional policy.

title: 救治建议与原记录分开
Separate proposed care from source records
rows: 疑出血以血制品为主、限制晶体；无重型TBI未止血期SBP80–90 mmHg为参考。不是将原病历“加压补液”改写成已输血。以本院规范为准。

For suspected hemorrhage prioritize blood, limit crystalloid; SBP80–90 is a reference before control without severe TBI. Do not rewrite original pressurized fluid as confirmed transfusion. Follow institutional policy.
过敏性反应伴低压/呼吸受损：成人肾上腺素0.5 mg IM，必要时5 min重复，按本院过敏急救流程。AMPLE的A询问过敏；糖皮质激素后改善不能证明病因或替代一线肾上腺素。以本院规范为准。

Anaphylaxis with circulatory/respiratory compromise: adult adrenaline0.5 mg IM, repeat after five minutes if needed per local pathway. AMPLE A asks allergies; improvement after steroids neither proves causality nor substitutes first-line adrenaline. Follow institutional policy.

title: 先选同一体系，再作分诊
Choose one system before triage
成人START
Adult START
rows: 行走先绿；开放气道仍无呼吸为黑；RR>30、无桡动脉/CRT>2 s、不能遵嘱任一为红；其余黄。初次标签仍需复评。以本院规范为准。

Walking initially green; apnea after airway opening black; RR over30, absent radial pulse/CRT over two seconds, or inability to obey commands red; otherwise yellow. Reassess initial tags. Follow institutional policy.

title: 儿童JumpSTART
Pediatric JumpSTART
rows: 呼吸15–45次/分，结合脉搏及AVPU反应；无呼吸先开放气道，无脉黑，有脉先5次人工呼吸：恢复呼吸红，仍无呼吸黑。不能与SALT儿童2次通气混用。以本院规范为准。

Respiratory range15–45/min plus pulse/AVPU. Apnea→open airway; absent pulse black, palpable pulse→five breaths: breathing returns red, persistent apnea black. Do not mix with SALT pediatric two breaths. Follow institutional policy.

title: SALT/MUCC
SALT/MUCC
rows: 先不动/明显威胁→有目的动作→能走者；止大出血、开放气道（儿童2次通气）、受训胸减压/解毒后分个体风险。红立即、黄延迟、绿轻伤、灰期待、黑死亡；灰需姑息镇痛与资源变化复评。以本院规范为准。

Global order: still/obvious threat, purposeful movement, walking; control hemorrhage/open airway(two pediatric breaths)/trained decompression/antidote before individual assessment. Red immediate/yellow delayed/green minimal/gray expectant/black dead; gray needs palliation and resource reassessment. Follow institutional policy.

title: 国内颜色与事件级别
Chinese colors and event levels
rows: 2006预案轻/重/危重/死亡为蓝/黄/红/黑；其他体系绿色不可直接等同。团体标准绿色版本及2025规范现场流程图尚需指定原文核查，不拼接算法。以本院规范为准。

2006 plan minor/serious/critical/dead colors are blue/yellow/red/black; do not equate green from other systems. Specific association-green and2025 on-scene diagrams await original-text checking; no mixed algorithm. Follow institutional policy.
事件Ⅱ/Ⅲ/Ⅳ的数字是死亡和危重病例合计>5/>3/>1，还须伤亡规模/跨区或有关部门确定等完整条件；Ⅰ含国家支援请求/跨省严重事件，非只数死亡。以本院规范为准。

LevelII/III/IV uses deaths AND critical cases combined over5/3/1 with the full casualty-scale/cross-region/authority conditions. LevelI includes national support requests/cross-province severity, not death count alone. Follow institutional policy.

title: 挤压综合征：解救前就准备高钾风险
Crush syndrome: prepare for hyperkalemia before release
灾害挤压补液参考
Disaster-crush fluid reference
rows: ERBP2012：尽早解救前等渗盐水，成人1000 mL/h、儿童15–20 mL/kg/h；2 h后成人不超过500 mL/h、儿童约10 mL/kg/h或更低。禁机械套用大出血/TBI/心肾衰者。以本院规范为准。

ERBP2012: early pre-extrication saline, adult1000 mL/h/child15–20 mL/kg/h; after two hours adult at most500/child about10 mL/kg/h or lower. Do not mechanically apply to bleeding/TBI/cardiac-renal failure. Follow institutional policy.
此前未补液者首6 h可用3–6 L的历史参考，须按尿量/肺部/既往已输量调整；少尿无尿或肺水肿停止盲目追加，早期肾科/透析支持。不是每位伤员的固定目标。以本院规范为准。

Historical first-six-hour3–6 L reference for previously unresuscitated victims requires urine/lung/prior-volume titration. Oliguria/anuria/pulmonary edema stops blind loading and prompts renal/dialysis support; not a fixed target for every victim. Follow institutional policy.
该灾害规范避免含钾液如乳酸林格；连续心电/钾，准备钙剂、胰岛素葡萄糖、透析路径；具体治疗按本院高钾流程。以本院规范为准。

This disaster guideline avoids potassium-containing fluid such as lactated Ringer; monitor ECG/potassium and prepare calcium/insulin-glucose/dialysis pathways per local hyperkalemia protocol. Follow institutional policy.

title: P4能行走，也需要爆炸伤复评
Walking P4 still needs blast reassessment
四种机制与迟发风险
Four mechanisms and delayed risk
rows: 一级冲击波（肺/耳/空腔）；二级破片；三级抛掷撞击；四级烧伤/吸入/挤压等。爆震肺可迟至48 h出现表现；鼓膜破裂单独不能衡量重伤，也不能排除。以本院规范为准。

Primary pressure wave(lung/ear/hollow organs), secondary fragments, tertiary displacement, quaternary burns/inhalation/crush. Lung signs may appear up to48 hours; isolated eardrum rupture neither measures nor excludes serious injury. Follow institutional policy.
倒置分诊可能轻伤先到；CDC早期资料用首小时人数×2粗估首波，不能作固定资源启动阈值，持续核对实际到达与后续通知。以本院规范为准。

Inverted triage may bring minor injuries first. Older CDC material uses first-hour arrivals×2 as a rough first-wave estimate, not a fixed activation threshold; update actual arrivals/pre-alerts. Follow institutional policy.

title: CBRN：分区与去污保护患者和团队
CBRN: zones and decontamination protect patients and teams
先离开污染，再按物质去污
Leave contamination, decontaminate by substance
rows: 热区受控危险源、温区去污、冷区清洁救治；按危险评估PPE。脱衣去除大部分表面污染、妥善封袋，兼顾隐私与保温。以本院规范为准。

Controlled hot hazard zone, warm decontamination zone, cold clean-care zone; hazard-based PPE. Disrobe/remove much surface contamination and bag clothing while preserving privacy/warmth. Follow institutional policy.
通常先干式吸附/去污、必要时湿去污；遇水反应物质需专门流程，不能一律冲水。救命干预与防护去污协同，按本院预案衔接。以本院规范为准。

Usually dry absorption/decontamination then wet as indicated; water-reactive materials need a specific procedure, not universal washing. Coordinate lifesaving care, PPE and decontamination locally. Follow institutional policy.

title: 开放骨折：抗生素、清创与覆盖
Open fracture: antibiotics, debridement and coverage
